row.proto: void Vm_Binding_SetSourceAndResolve(void *binding, void *arg, void **source_node, char force_full)
row.notes: Rebinds a VM data binding: swaps the intrusive ref-counted source node handle at +0x80, calls FUN_1442b8d10, then either resolves the target node into +0x98 directly (FUN_144292c70, following up to 0x62 reference hops when flag 2 of +0xe0 is set) or, when force_full or flag 0x10 is set, walks the path segments (count byte +0x78, 8 bytes each from +0), subscribes FUN_1442be5e0 as change handler, fires an initial change event and registers the binding in the registry hash set (+0x98..+0xcc of g_Vm_Registry). Flag byte at +0xe0.
